title: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Research Associate III Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Research Associate III position. Candidates who have qualified in MD/MS, MDS, M.V.Sc, M.Pharm, M.E/ M.Tech, or Ph.D can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates...
